summary: Completed comprehensive testing of GOLFGATE Catalunya major redesign. All features verified: 20 course cards in 3-column grid (GIM-style with image top, text below), 3-column footer (Description+Social, Quick Links, Services, Contact Info), weather 3-day forecast dropdown, admin login protection (admin/golfgate2026), blog CRUD, no duplicate peralada-2 course, QuickView modal with fixed image.

homepage.details: 20 course cards in 3-column grid, navbar with logo/links/weather/language/admin/CTA

course_cards_redesign.details: Cards match GIM layout: image top with eye icon + price badge, text below with location, course name (clickable), description, HOLES/PAR row, 'Hover for details' text

card_flip_animation.details: 1.2s hover delay before flip, 0.8s transition, Electric Kiwi gradient on back with booking button and 'View Course Details' link

footer_3_column.details: Left: description + social icons (FB/IG/X), Middle: Quick Links (Home/Golf Courses/Contact), Right: Services (Book a tee time/Book Tee Times Catalunya)

footer_contact_info.details: Phone: +34 620 987 575, Email: contact@golfgatecatalunya.es, Location: Barcelona, CT, Spain, Website: golfgatecatalunya.es link

footer_copyright.details: © 2026 Golfgatecatalunya.es® with registered trademark, Privacy Policy, Terms of Service links

weather_3day_forecast.details: Weather badge shows temperature, clicking opens dropdown with 'Barcelona, Today' and 3-day forecast (day names, icons, high/low temps)

admin_login_protection.details: /admin shows login page, credentials admin/golfgate2026 grant access

admin_course_cards_tab.details: Shows 20 courses table with Edit button, clicking Edit opens modal with fields (name, location, price, holes, par, full_address, booking URL)

admin_blog_posts_tab.details: Shows 'No Blog Posts Yet' empty state, 'New Post' button opens modal with title, author, category, content, published toggle

quickview_modal.details: Eye icon opens modal with fixed image (object-cover), course details, booking button

course_name_navigation.details: Course name on card front is clickable and navigates to /courses/{id}

view_course_details_link.details: 'View Course Details' link on card back navigates to /courses/{id}

explore_golf_courses_button.details: Hero button smoothly scrolls to courses section

google_maps_links.details: Location links use full_address field for accurate Google Maps directions

no_duplicate_peralada.details: API returns exactly 20 courses, no peralada-2 duplicate

GET /api/catalunya-courses.details: Returns exactly 20 active courses with all required fields

GET /api/catalunya-courses/{id}.details: Returns single course with correct data including full_address

POST /api/admin/blog-posts.details: Creates new blog post with id, title, content, category, author, published

DELETE /api/admin/blog-posts/{id}.details: Deletes blog post and returns {deleted: true}
